# Traps.txt - trap machine-instruction range (starter)
# A trap raises the current instruction stream into the diagnostic
# subsystem and does NOT advance the cursor (control / type 1).
RANGE  7FFFFFF0-7FFFFFFE
UNASSIGNED  7FFFFFF0-7FFFFFFE   each trap codepoint pending assignment
SEE    sucs_bancode_to_trap()   dispatch of diagnostic blocks via traps
